newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PERUGIA COACH ADMITTED TO HEART UNIT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PERUGIA COACH ADMITTED TO HEART UNIT.

text.p: Giovanni Galeone, the embattled manager of newly promoted serie A side Perugia, was admitted to hospital on Tuesday with a heart problem.

Galeone, whose job has been on the line since his team was knocked out of the Italian Cup by part-timers Nocerina two weeks ago, was being treated at the heart unit of the Santa Maria hospital in the port of Ravenna.

"His clinical condition is good but we can't say at the moment what caused him to be admitted. We should be able to be more precise (after tests) tomorrow afternoon," a heart specialist at the hospital said.

Galeone, whose contract expires in 1998, has been fighting for his job since Nocerina beat Perugia 2-1 in a second round cup replay two weeks ago, denying them a lucrative third round tie against Juventus.

He won something of a reprieve from a threat of dismissal by owner Luciano Gaucci on Sunday when Perugia beat Atalanta 3-1 in their first league match since the defeat to haul themselves up to 11th in the table.
